text:
elaine: Quick flag from onboarding: multiple sample apps still accept REDWOOD_LEGACY and REDWOOD_KEY; we should announce EOL and provide a migration path to REDWOOD_API_KEY. New hires hit this today.

marc: Agreed. Propose deprecation timeline: announce now, 30-day opt-in compatibility warnings, then 90-day forced migration. During warning period SDKs should log a single deprecation warning per process when a legacy env is used.

nate: Also we need a sandbox story: sandbox tokens (prefix sb_) should be allowed in local dev but never in CI. Add SDK helper is_sandbox_token() so sampleapps can refuse to run in CI if sb_ found.

elaine: Good call. And document a short migration script: prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY; if only REDWOOD_LEGACY present, copy it to REDWOOD_API_KEY and emit note. Example in sampleapps/migrate-cred.sh.

marc: Parity: JS/Go already accept both names; Python only reads REDWOOD_API_KEY. Python should be tolerant during deprecation and emit the single-time warning.

nate: Rotation detail: support exchange endpoint POST /v1/sessions for rk_->rs_ as discussed, and include header X-Token-Type in responses so SDKs can learn token lifecycle. SDKs should not retry 401 and should raise AuthError with code "RotatedTokenSuspected" when appropriate.

devx-infra: We'll add a cred-lint rule to CI that flags REDWOOD_KEY/REDWOOD_LEGACY usage and blocks merges after the EOL date. Also add a check to onboarding CI to detect sandbox tokens in production pipelines.

elaine: Telemetry: emit auth.deprecation.warn and auth.rotation.suspected events (one per process) to help ops correlate onboarding breakages. Make sure no PII.

marc: I'll draft the announcement + RFC with timeline and include sample migration scripts and the sandbox guidance. Who can update SDKs?

nate: I'll take Python + sampleapp scripts.

marc: I'll take JS; devx-infra will handle Go + cred-lint.

elaine: Great — landing these should make onboarding smoother next week. Thanks!
